meaningOfPilot: Test release number; not a separate Power Light product

requiredCapabilities.name: Inherited network boundary and fail-closed gateway
First-use setup followed by saved-config daily launch
Official update lifecycle without widening the network policy
Real local MCP integration in authenticated desktop session
Authenticated application reads and writes authorized project files
Official desktop extensions install and execute inside boundary
Real login, OAuth callbacks and authentication continuity
Global shortcuts, notifications and required system integrations
Clearly declare Code and Cowork feature scope
Organizational publisher signature and platform trust acceptance
Installation, exit and recovery without host network changes
Resource limits and ordinary customer-machine compatibility
Runtime evidence of isolated authentication, configuration and extension storage paths

releaseRules: Do not relabel a pilot as FULL_DESKTOP by changing filenames or copy.
Passing installer and unauthenticated UI tests does not accept authenticated functionality.
Do not enable privileged system delegation just to pass a usability test before its network boundary is implemented.
Do not remove first-stage assessment tooling when replacing a second-stage product.
Preserve the latest tested packages and recovery copies while developing the full-desktop implementation.
